answer.verdict: No catalog WE-TORPFC part provides BOTH approximately 258 uH at the 23.2719 A bias AND a published core+AC loss. The closest-bias-match candidate (760801403) has an acceptable DC-only delta (~3.4-5.0 W) leaving ~6.8-8.5 W of the 11.82 W saving for core+AC, but those terms are unpublished for every part in the family, so the decision cannot be closed from sources. Whether the delta is under 11.82 W is UNKNOWN.
answer.best_candidate_core_plus_ac_reason: not published in the datasheet; no core-loss curve, no core material data, no Rac/Rdc(f); not inferred from DCR

unresolved_findings: Core loss at 90 kHz / 23.27 A bias is unpublished for the baseline and every candidate; it is the single most decision-relevant missing term.
AC winding loss at 90 kHz with 4.20 A pk-pk ripple is unpublished for every part.

The 258.215 uH target is a constant-L model equivalent; the retained baseline's own published curve falls to ~159.7 uH at the 23.2719 A peak, so the model is ~13% optimistic about the baseline at the peak. A bias-matched target (candidate derating like the baseline) would be ~229 uH at peak.
L tolerance at bias / at temperature is not published; only a typical +20 degC curve.
Thermal ratings are at dT=40 K with a stated airflow; the 15 A envelope exceeds every candidate's no-fan rating and depends on 4 m/s forced air.
recommended_next_observation: Obtain core loss (and, second, AC winding loss) at 90 kHz and the 23.27 A DC-bias operating point for 760801403 and for the retained 760800301 - from the manufacturer's loss tool or a vendor loss statement - then compute (DC+AC+core)_candidate - (DC+AC+core)_baseline and compare to 11.8202 W.
